setup: CREATE TABLE ev(id INT, ts INT)
CREATE TABLE px(id INT, ts INT, p INT)
F3.q: SELECT px.p FROM ev ASOF JOIN px ON ev.id = px.id AND ev.ts >= px.ts ORDER BY ev.id, ev.ts, px.p

F7.q: SELECT d + INTERVAL '1 month' d1, d + INTERVAL '30 days' d2 FROM t ORDER BY d

setup: CREATE TABLE issue23979_l(o INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE issue23979_r(o INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, wh INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE issue23979_s2(o INTEGER, wh INTEGER)
F1.q: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM issue23979_s2 x WHERE x.o = l.o AND r.wh <> x.wh ) AS correlated_exists, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM issue23979_s2 x WHERE x.o = l.o AND (r.wh + 0) <> x.wh ) AS equivalent_rewrite FROM issue23979_l l LEFT JOIN issue23979_r r USING (o) JOIN issue23979_s2 s2 USING (o) ORDER BY l.o

setup: CREATE TABLE src(a INTEGER, b INTEGER, v INTEGER)
F2.q: SELECT SUM(v) OVER (PARTITION BY a, a, b) AS w_aab, SUM(v) OVER (PARTITION BY a, a, a) AS w_aaa FROM src ORDER BY b

setup: CREATE TABLE t8a (id INTEGER, s VARCHAR);
CREATE TABLE t8b (id INTEGER, s VARCHAR);
F8.q: SELECT s COLLATE NOCASE AS s_nc FROM t8a UNION SELECT s COLLATE NOCASE AS s_nc FROM t8b ORDER BY s_nc

setup: CREATE TABLE t (x INTEGER, y INTEGER);
F9.q: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN x IS NULL THEN 'n' WHEN x > y THEN 'gt' WHEN x = y THEN 'eq' ELSE 'lt' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total FROM t ORDER BY bucket;

CREATE TABLE right_table (id INTEGER, category INTEGER, budget INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE ordered_probe(flag BOOLEAN, ord INTEGER)
F5.q: WITH c AS ( SELECT flag FROM ordered_probe ORDER BY ord OFFSET 2 ) SELECT * FROM c INNER JOIN boolean_keys ON flag = flag_key

setup: CREATE TABLE accounts (acct_id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner VARCHAR, balance NUMERIC(18,4), created DATE, active BOOLEAN, last_seen TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id BIGINT NOT NULL, acct_id INTEGER, amount DOUBLE PRECISION, status VARCHAR, placed DATE)
F6.q: SELECT o1.amount FROM orders o1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.acct_id = o1.acct_id AND o2.order_id <> o1.order_id AND o2.amount > o1.amount)
